sources.title: deepseek-ai / deepseek-v4-flash
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Flash is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 284 billion total parameters and 13 billion activated parameters. DeepSeek-V4-Flash was developed by DeepSeek as a part of DeepSeek-V4 collection.
